title: Direct Salts Lemon Lime 10ml E-Liquid
description: Direct Salts Lemon Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid provides a clean and highly refreshing citrus experience. The blend opens with the sharp, acidic punch of fresh Lemon, offering an immediate and vibrant inhale. This is flawlessly matched by the slightly sweeter, distinctively aromatic zest of ripe Lime on the exhale. The combination provides a continuously bright and mouth-watering citrus experience. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Direct Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Direct Salts collection offers vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and confectionery profiles. Providing a highly cost-effective and flexible option, this 10ml range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the sharp citrus bite of Lemon Lime, vapers can explore other compelling options such as the rich Strawberry Raspberry Cherry, the cooling Pineapple Ice, or the sweet Blueberry Raspberry.
